question: In December 2020, the Ministry of Home Affairs declared the entire State of ______ as a ‘disturbed area’ for six more months under the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958 (AFSPA).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In December 2020, the Ministry of Home Affairs declared the entire State of **Nagaland** as a ‘disturbed area’ for six more months under the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958 (AFSPA).
 
• The decision has been taken as killings, loots and extortion cases have been going on in various parts of the state.
 
• AFSPA empowers security forces to conduct operations anywhere and arrest anyone without any prior warrant.
 
• The Armed Forces Special Powers Act has been in force in Nagaland for several decades.
 
• Nagaland acquired statehood in **1963.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• AFSPA was passed on 11th September 1958 for civil rights activists from** Manipur.**
 
• AFSPA was first enacted to deal with the Naga insurgency in the **Assam region.**
 
• The central government enacted the Armed Forces (**Punjab and Chandigarh**) Special Powers Act in 1983.
